name: Teens4Animals Council
what_you_do: Council members plan and lead animal welfare events at school and in the community. They staff booths at Humane Society events. They speak up for animals. They can start an animal club at their school.
who_can_apply: Students. The page does not state ages or grades; check the application. Members serve a one-year term, volunteer at events and attend quarterly meetings.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The 4-day training fee is waived for council members.
duration: One-year term (2026-2027), with 4-day summer training and quarterly meetings
deadline_text: 2026-2027 applications are closed. The page does not say when the next application opens. The 2026 training was June 22 to 25, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teens4Animals Council form when it opens.
notes: Members attend quarterly meetings and field trips on topics such as responsible fishing and ethical farming. The page does not state an age or grade rule.
